title: Sculpt Your Own Light
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. Sunday, October 19, 2025 1:00 – 4:00 pm | Ages 11+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora Unleash your creativity in this hands-on workshop where simple materials transform into stunning, illuminated sculptures. Over the course of three hours, you’ll have the opportunity to experiment with wire and paper, shaping and crafting a unique piece that not only serves as a captivating sculpture but also functions as a decorative light. Whether you’re a seasoned artist or a beginner, this workshop encourages free-flowing creativity and exploration. By the end of the workshop, you’ll take home your very own handmade light sculpture, a beautiful fusion of art and functionality. Materials fee is $20 payable to the instructor by cash
